zh.name: 用场景插画表达观点
zh.summary: 每页用一个完整场景将观点具体化，让细节揭示容易被忽略的处境。
zh.useWhen: 每页场景可独立理解；区别于连续人物事件构成的漫画故事。
zh.instructions: 明确观点、独立场景、角色处境与可确认事实
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Illustrated Opinion Scenes
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the illustrated opinion scenes structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the illustrated opinion scenes format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 全幅原创编辑插画，人物关系占70–85%，场景中两段手写文字36–44px分别隶属公开判断与被忽略的处境
文字置天空/墙面等留白，可用细尾线，不另加大面板
exclusions: 同一问题的不同角色视角
